sentences.text:
Nawab Singh Parihar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10
January, 2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Gwl:644
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Gwalior

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Rajendra Kumar Vani

On The 10th Of January, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 46517 of 2024
 Nawab Singh Parihar
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Daya Ram Sharma - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Dinesh Savita - Public Prosecutor for the respon
 Ms.Madulika Jadaon - Advocate for the complainant.

Order 
This first application filed by the applicant under Section 482 of BNSS 2023 for grant of anticipatory bail relating to Crime No.207 of 2024 registered at Police Station Sewda, District Datia (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 376-D, 506 of IPC.
The allegation against the present applicant and co-accused Uttam Mahor is of gang rape on the prosecutrix.
It is submitted by the learned counsel of the present applicant that this is an anticipatory bail on behalf of appellant Nawab Singh.
He has been falsely implicated in this case.
Prosecutrix herself is present in this case and she has no objection on the anticipatory bail of the present applicant.

It is also submitted that co-accused Uttam Mahor has also been granted regular NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:644 2 MCRC-46517-2024 bail by this Court vide order dated 25.10.2024 passed in M.Cr.C.No.45743/2024.
It is also submitted that to that effect prosecutrix herself submitted an affidavit of her and she expressed her no objection of the bail application.
He is ready to abide by all the conditions which may be imposed by the Court.
The applicant is a resident of District Datia (M.P.).
There is no possibility of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
Prosecutrix has been identified by her Advocate Ms. Madulika Jadon.
Under these circumstances, the applicant is entitled to get the benefit of anticipatory bail.
Per contra learned counsel for the State opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.

Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary.

Having considered the rival submissions and the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that in case, if the applicant appears before the Investigating Officer/trial Court within fifteen days from today and furnishes personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Investigating Officer/trial Court, then he shall be released on anticipatory bail.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:644 3 MCRC-46517-2024 It is made clear that in case if applicant fails to appear before the Investigating Officer/trial Court within the fifteen days from today, then this order shall automatically stand cancelled.
